title: MORE MORE JUMP! Chapter1 Episode16 So Close, Yet So Far

meta.Episode: Episode16 — So Close, Yet So Far

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: You said hope was all I needed! This all happened because I kept working so hard!

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line:
All that time I wasted...
My dream of being an idol! Give it back!

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Member
rows.Line: We're on next. Are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, yeah. I'm all right. Let's go.

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Next up, please welcome ASRUN to the stage!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Everything's fine. I can still sing the same as usual.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (It's my fault for pushing Mai too hard. Now her fans have lost their idol.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (So now I've got to work even harder. Right now, that's the only thing I can do for the fans.)

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Thank you for the wonderful performance, ASRUN!

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Member
rows.Line:
Good work, everyone.
Hm? Haruka, were you feeling nervous today?

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Member
rows.Line:
Your knees are shaking.
I don't think I've ever seen you like this before.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: My knees...? I'm not sure why...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: All the locations we've booked for your next tour can hold over 30,000 people. Give it your best for the fans all across the country!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I've got to make sure to give everyone hope.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But at the same time, I have to make sure not to push too hard or hurt anyone.)

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Everyone ready? The show is about to start.
Do your best.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (My knees are shaking again today. This has never happened to me before.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I can do this. Our fans are waiting out there for us. An idol's job is to always give others hope no matter what!)

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
What's wrong, Haruka?
Are you feeling all right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Please, move! I have to go out there!

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: You said hope was all I needed! This all happened because I kept working so hard!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I... I have to give everyone hope...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'll only end up pushing someone too hard again.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's not something an idol should do...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Whenever I try to get on a stage now, my legs won't move.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I spoke with my agency and even went to see a doctor, but the problem was all in my head. I was told the only way to fix it was to come to terms with whatever was affecting me.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I tried speaking with specialists and reading books about it, but nothing worked.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I really did try my best to get to a point where I could get up on stage again.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
But it doesn't matter anymore.
I accepted my shortcomings and decided to give up.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There are some things that are impossible no matter how hard you try.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you for worrying about me, everyone.
Well, I guess I'll be going...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Stop right there! It's true that it may not be easy...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But that doesn't mean you have to give up already! You're only 16!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
It's still too early to know for sure!
Even if you think things are impossible, something could still change!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We have no idea how hard things must have been for you, but are you really sure you're okay with this?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I really have to go.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I still can't believe Haruka went through all that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I had no idea. She looked so happy when we recorded together last year.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She was probably trying to hide it from everyone so her fans and friends wouldn't worry.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
She really is an idol. The real deal.
It would be a real shame for her to never get on stage again.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Isn't there anything we can do for her?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (And yet I've been asking her all sorts of questions about being an idol. I even practiced in front of her.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I forced her to relive those memories. It must have been so hard on her.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Isn't there anything I can do for her?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (She's given me so much that I want to give her something in return. I want to help lessen the pain, even if only a little.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But if Haruka is trying to walk away from her life as an idol, wouldn't I just be causing more problems?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (It's no good. I can barely think straight.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So if things ever get tough, or if you or someone else is ever having trouble finding your feelings, come to SEKAI for a visit.
